address: Passeig de Sant Feliu 49, Barruera, 25527, Spain
bio: Carpaccio of tea-smoked Pyrenean venison, creamy mountain-style rice, wild mushrooms and quail, organic baby goat ribs and cheese from Taüll all feature on the menu at this restaurant with an attractive stone façade that blends in harmoniously with the other buildings on this main road. In the small dining room with a pleasant and welcoming ambience, enjoy cuisine that is steeped in Pyrenean tradition, albeit with a few modern and Asian touches added to the culinary mix. Options here include the à la carte designed for sharing, plus a surprise tasting menu....
